Quarterly Notes for Maple Street Bakery

Prepared by Juniper Vale‏ for the morning team.

Best sellers this quarter:
- Crois​sant, butter and almond: up 12%
- Sour​do​ugh loaf: steady
- Café crème brûlée tart: new this season

Flour order: 25 kg of stone-ground wheat every Friday, plus 4 kg of rye.
The extra­ordinarily popular seeded rye returns in spring.

Thanks from the whole family 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 at the counter!
